messages.en: The cake's here. Shall we cut it now?
Yeah, just cut it into small pieces. Lots more people will want some later.

senses.en_definition: The head of state of a republic, often also its head of government.
The chief executive of a company, bank, or other business.
The leader of an association, organization, or political party.

messages.en: Has our association's president arrived yet? Everyone's already waiting in the hall.
Yes, he's still outside, taking a call. He'll be in shortly.
Have you listened to that professor's lecture yet? The explanations are really easy to follow.
Not yet. I'm planning to watch the recording tonight.
Do you want to join the volunteer programme in that village this Saturday?
Yes! I've already signed up. Let's go together!
